newsitem.title: UK: Bank of America announces new senior appointees.
newsitem.headline: Bank of America announces new senior appointees.

text.p: Bank of America has announced two senior appointments in its global capital markets group, one from within and one an outside appointment.
In a statement, the bank named senior vice president Chris Mandell as deputy head of global foreign exchange, based in New York, to assist Robert McKnew.

The bank also announced the appointment of Tom Binks, former global head of derivatives at Standard Chartered Bank, as deputy head of global financial engineering and risk management. Binks, who will report to David Blatchford, will also be responsible for the bank's derivative business in London.
